title: Fix pipe routing and fluid connectivity for chemical science factories
description: Chemical science pack factories do not produce functional piping. Chemical plants and fluid networks fail to route and connect pipes correctly during factory synthesis and layout generation. Investigate fluid routing, pipe rasterization, and underground jumper resolution to restore functional fluid piping.

title: Support multi-domain PDN and power-gated factory controllers
Support off-chip power generation for factory floorplans
description: Only place electric poles in standard cells and core routing. Remove electricity generators from individual cell macros. Synthesize a single external generator outside the floorplan boundary and connect it to the Power Distribution Network (PDN).

title: Synthesize dedicated power plants for factory designs
description: Calculate required factory electrical wattage from machine demands. Synthesize dedicated power plant sub-layouts (such as steam boilers, solar fields, or nuclear power plants) and connect them to the factory Power Distribution Network (PDN).
